description: This file contains JavaScript functions for handling popup windows, inter-window communication, and form interactions in the SuiteCRM project. It manages popup creation, returning selected data from popups to parent forms, and constructs initial filters for specific form fields.

methods.name: get_popup_request_data()
methods.description: Returns the JSON stringified current popup request data stored in the window document.

methods.name: get_close_popup()
methods.description: Retrieves the close_popup function or data from the window document.

methods.name: open_popup(module_name, width, height, initial_filter, close_popup, hide_clear_button, popup_request_data, popup_mode, create, metadata)
methods.description: Opens a new popup window with specified parameters for module, size, filter, and other options, manages popup count, and encodes request data for the popup.

methods.name: set_return(popup_reply_data)
methods.description: Populates a form with data returned from a popup window based on the form's name and a key-value pair object.

methods.name: set_return_and_save(popup_reply_data)
methods.description: Sets form data from popup reply and triggers form submission to save the data.

methods.name: set_return_and_save_targetlist(popup_reply_data)
methods.description: Sets multiple form fields with popup data and submits multiple forms for a list view target operation, with additional handling for selected checkboxes.

methods.name: get_element_index(form_index, element_name)
methods.description: Finds the index of a form element by name within a specific form.

methods.name: get_initial_filter_by_account(form_name)
methods.description: Constructs an initial filter string for a form based on account ID and name fields.

ctags.name: open_popup
ctags.pattern: /^function open_popup(module_name, width, height, initial_filter, close_popup, hide_clear_button, /
ctags.signature: (module_name, width, height, initial_filter, close_popup, hide_clear_button, popup_request_data, popup_mode, create, metadata)
